**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 16:49  
[USER] User asked how to configure the settings for automatic updates on their Android smartphone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide on configuring automatic updates on an Android smartphone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Open the "Google Play Store" app on your Android smartphone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Tap on the three horizontal lines (the "hamburger" menu) in the top left corner of the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: From the menu that appears, select "Settings."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Scroll down to the "General" section and tap on "Auto-update apps."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 5: Three options will appear - "Do not auto-update apps," "Auto-update apps over any network," and "Auto-update apps over Wi-Fi only."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 6: If "Auto-update apps over Wi-Fi only" is chosen, ensure the smartphone is connected to a Wi-Fi network.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 7: To disable automatic updates, select "Do not auto-update apps."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant concluded that the user has successfully configured the settings for automatic updates on their Android smartphone.  
[USER] User asked how to check which apps have been updated automatically.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide on checking which apps have been updated automatically on an Android smartphone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Open the "Google Play Store" app on your Android smartphone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Tap on the three horizontal lines (the "hamburger" menu) in the top left corner of the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: From the menu that appears, select "My apps & games."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Two tabs will be visible - "Updates" and "Installed." The "Updates" tab shows all apps that have been updated or have pending updates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 5: Apps that have been updated automatically will have a tag that says "Updated" next to them.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 6: To see the update history of a particular app, tap on the app and scroll down to the "Version history" section.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant concluded that the user can now check which apps have been updated automatically on their Android smartphone.  
[USER] User expressed satisfaction,
